                loc = links_inside_nav.nth(i)
                try:
                    txt = (await loc.inner_text() or "").strip()
                except Exception:
                    txt = ""
                lower = txt.lower()
                if txt == "5" or lower == "5" or "page 5" in lower or lower.endswith(" 5") or lower.startswith("5 "):
                    await loc.click()
                    return

    # 4) Try a page-level direct link lookup for '5' as a fallback
    page_link5 = page.get_by_role("link", name="5")
    if await page_link5.count() > 0:
        # If found at page-level, click it
        await page_link5.first.click()
        return

    # 5) Scan all page links for textual variants (guarded by count checks)
    all_links = page.get_by_role("link")
    if await all_links.count() > 0:
        total_links = await all_links.count()
        for i in range(total_links):
            loc = all_links.nth(i)
            try:
                txt = (await loc.inner_text() or "").strip()
            except Exception:
                txt = ""
            lower = txt.lower()
            if txt == "5" or lower == "5" or "page 5" in lower or lower == "page 5":
                await loc.click()
                return

    # 6) Last resort: run a DOM query to find anchors whose visible text matches page-5 patterns
    href = await page.evaluate(r"""() => {
        const anchors = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a'))
        for (const a of anchors) {
            const t = (a.textContent || '').trim()
            if (!t) continue
            if (t === '5' || /page\s*5/i.test(t) || /\b5\b/.test(t)) {
                const h = a.getAttribute('href')
                if (h) return h
                if (a.href) return a.href
            }
        }
        return null
    }""")

    if href:
        # Use relative goto-friendly navigation (page.goto will accept relative or absolute hrefs)
        await page.goto(href)
        return

    # If no page-5 control was found, do nothing further
    return
